description: This file contains implementation of LXC container management, including classes for container configuration, network interface iteration, container lifecycle control (start, stop, memory, CPU info), and administrator singleton for container creation and logging.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network interfaces inside an LXC container.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container with methods for lifecycle management, configuration, and resource monitoring.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Container configuration class for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing LXC containers, including creation, logging, and global configuration.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to an initial state.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is valid.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::NumAddresses
methods.description: Returns the number of IP addresses for the current interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the IP address at the specified index.

methods.name: LXCContainer::LXCContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing container with configuration.

methods.name: LXCContainer::~LXCContainer
methods.description: Destructor stopping container if running and cleaning up.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Id
methods.description: Returns container's identifier.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage info for the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU core usage info for the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a timeout.

methods.name: LXCContainer::AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and releases container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::InheritRequestedEnvironment
methods.description: Inherits environment variables from host into container configuration.
